channel.title: LiVEUO — pharCare pharmacy software guides
channel.description: Daily guides on pharmacy billing, GST compliance, and inventory control for Indian pharmacies.

item.title: Purchase order automation: ordering from data, not memory
item.description: Reorder levels, movement-based suggestions, scheme evaluation and distributor comparison — replacing the habit that causes stockouts and expiry at the same time.

item.title: Barcode scanning at the pharmacy counter: what it fixes
item.description: Scanning speeds up billing, but its real value is batch capture and dispensing accuracy. Which codes carry expiry data, and how to handle packs with none.

item.title: GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B for pharmacies: getting to a clean monthly filing
item.description: What your billing system must produce for a pharmacy GST return to reconcile first time: rate-wise splits, B2B separation, linked credit notes, HSN summaries.

item.title: Schedule X and narcotic registers: controlled-substance records
item.description: Duplicate prescriptions, locked storage, separate records and zero tolerance for variance. What controlled-substance record-keeping demands of your software.

item.title: A pharmacy stock audit that actually finds the variance
item.description: Full counts, cycle counts, and how to investigate a discrepancy instead of adjusting it away. A pharmacy stock audit procedure that finds the actual cause.

item.title: Why product-level stock tracking fails in a pharmacy
item.description: Two batches of one medicine can carry different MRPs, expiry dates and costs. Why batch is the correct unit of pharmacy stock, and what breaks without it.

item.title: Pharmacy billing software pricing in India: the real cost
item.description: Licence versus subscription, per-counter versus per-branch, and the costs quotes leave out. How to compare pharmacy software on total cost, not sticker price.

item.title: Multi-branch pharmacy billing: what to look for in software
item.description: Running three pharmacies is not running one pharmacy three times. What changes in stock visibility, transfers, pricing control, permissions and reporting.

item.title: Switching from Marg ERP to pharCare: a migration checklist
item.description: What to export, what to clean, what to reconcile, and how to run a parallel week — a step-by-step checklist for moving a pharmacy off Marg ERP safely.

item.title: How to reduce expired-stock write-offs in a retail pharmacy
item.description: Expired stock is pure margin loss and most of it is preventable. Batch discipline, near-expiry alerts, supplier return windows, and the buying that causes it.

item.title: GST invoicing for pharmacies: a practical guide
item.description: Multiple tax slabs on one bill, batch-level MRP, credit notes for expiry returns, and GSTR-ready exports. A working guide to GST invoicing in an Indian retail pharmacy.

item.title: Schedule H, H1 and H1X: what pharmacy software must track
item.description: Schedule H, H1 and H1X carry different record-keeping duties. Exactly what your pharmacy billing software must capture at the counter, and for how long.
